description: Query BGS borehole index or geology 625k features intersecting a WGS84 bounding box around a UK point (up to 10 km radius). Returns bounded properties and geometry summaries; bbox matches do not establish conditions at the exact point. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

collection.description: BGS collection identifier from bgs_collections; default onshoreboreholeindex.

lat.description: Confirmed WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees; pair with lon.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return; bounded by this tool's schema.

lon.description: Confirmed WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees; pair with lat.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres; spatial tools use a bounding box around the point.

name: bgs_features
